data.description:
Create the opus-tier agent definition file for the inference-incident curator.

File to create:
- plugins/dso/agents/inference-incident-curator.md

Required YAML frontmatter:
- name: inference-incident-curator
- model: opus
- description: (one-line description of scanning ticket history for inference incidents)
- color: (valid color string per project convention)

Required body content:
- Keyword scan logic for detecting inference incidents in ticket history
- Anti-hallucination validation step: cross-check inferred_decision_text against source ticket content before emitting a record
- ## CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT section documenting signal (name, when emitted: < 20 incidents found, format)
- Output format: JSONL per inference-incident-schema.md
- References to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-incident-schema.md and plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-envelope.md

AC: tests/scripts/test-inference-incident-curator-agent.sh passes (both test functions). model field = opus. File contains ## CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT section heading. RED marker for curator agent removed from .test-index.
